content.text:
Choose **Sol’s action-based implementation**, with Astra’s layout and fade-removal grafts.

| Candidate | Compact layout | Exact roll-up | Shared bars | Minimal ownership | Safety/testability | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Astra | 2 | 2 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 8/10 |
| Sol as proposed | 2 | 2 | 1 | 2 | 1 | 8/10 |
| Luna | 2 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 7/10 |
| Recommended combination | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 10/10 |

These are design scores, not runtime verification.

Use one internal Svelte action with typed `roll-up`, `row`, `bar`, and `fade` presets. Each attachment owns its animation handle, previous committed key, reduced-motion listener, and destruction cleanup. No public animation controller or feature-level motion state is needed. `Metric` and `SignedBarList` gain only optional `changeKey` props. Keep transform origins in component CSS, where geometry already lives.

**Explicitly accept initial SignedBarList entry animation.** Your brief permits this. Apply initial animation to its rows and bars, just as RankingList does. Existing nodes replay when the committed key changes; newly inserted rows animate on attachment. This also covers empty categories becoming populated, where `MemberSummary` currently mounts an entirely new `SignedBarList`. A component-local “initial render is static” observer misses that transition unless extra state crosses the feature boundary. That complexity is unnecessary for this request.

Metric and ContentChange remain static on initial attachment. Metric animates one persistent span containing the exact incoming formatted string. Keep the keyboard-scrollable `.member-total` region stationary, retain its accessible label and focus outline, and clip only its moving content. Unavailable text remains ordinary static text. Do not key the value subtree or duplicate accessible amounts.

Preserve RankingList’s actual existing recipe, including its implicit CSS `ease` easing, 300ms row duration, 420ms bar duration, 35ms stagger, and delayed backwards fill. Its negative bars still grow from the left because their existing geometry begins there. SignedBarList negative bars instead require `transform-origin: right`, matching their baseline attachment in `patterns.css`. The shared bar recipe should not infer origin from the negative flag.

Migrate ContentChange to the action’s `fade` preset while retaining its public contract. This is a small consolidation that removes its current independent media-query and cancellation implementation. Remove the MemberSummary outer fade. Keep FunderSummary’s fade around its lower content only, outside the animated total and controls.

Use feature-owned compact grids in both summaries rather than introducing `SummaryHeader`. Remove the obsolete full-span total rule. Keep native tabs and period controls persistent, with committed data and keys unchanged during pending navigation.

The **Laziness Protocol** shaped these choices. I read its leaf skill and applied its instruction to consolidate decisions and minimize the diff. Initial bar animation avoids added coordination state; migrating ContentChange avoids two lifecycle implementations.

Verification should cover inserted rows and empty-to-populated categories, repeated period changes, unchanged keys during pending navigation, negative transform origins, initial-static Metric, exact large decimals, focus and horizontal scrolling, live reduced-motion cancellation, ranking entry/stagger behavior, and compact layout at 320px. No edits or tests were performed.
